content: {"summary":"Customers report that purchases from the Windows 10 Store are not recognized by Xbox Live, even after re‑signing in, causing gameplay to fail.[#tk_2215140]\nUsers also face payment errors, such as split‑payment failures and spending‑limit blocks, preventing purchases of games like The Evil Within 2 and Ninja Gaiden Black.[#tk_2577472][#tk_2698189][#tk_2581265][#tk_1177418][#tk_2295995]\nSupport responses are often unhelpful, and the store interface fails to process transactions on Xbox One and Xbox 360, leaving customers frustrated.[#tk_2581229][#tk_1292265][#tk_340463]"}
